name: Gisa
description: Gisa is a necromancer and ghoulcaller from Innistrad, sister of Geralf Cecani, who raises the dead by whistling and singing.

summary.text: Gisa is a necromancer and ghoulcaller from Innistrad, sister of Geralf Cecani, who raises the dead by whistling and singing.

bio.text: Gisa escaped a prison caravan when skaabs attacked it, later revealed to have been sent by Geralf, and she returned to the old family home in Nephalia.
She befriended Nahiri, regarding her as her first friend, and raised an army of ghoul builders to construct a stone monument for her.
Later she ruled Thraben from the cathedral as the unchallenged queen of its army of the dead, writing bored letters to her brother.
When the risen ghoul Wilhelt marched on Thraben to win her love, she fought him and sent all the bats of Thraben against his army, driving him off.
Settled in the Engelturm, she and Geralf united against the invading Phyrexians, raising a moondrake and a colossal sea-beast and fighting with the dead.
On Thunder Junction she joined Oko's crew, raising zombies on the train, and she and Geralf were sent to Thief's Folly to retrieve the map.
At Thief's Folly she destroyed the beating heart and centipede that animated a giant corpsipede, and Oko later disbanded the crew with a promise of a future reunion.

status.text: As of March 2024 Gisa is alive and bickering with her brother Geralf, with Oko's crew disbanded.

timeline.summary: Grete reports no sign of Ludevic and that Gisa will be moved to Thraben, and Odric orders the escort tripled.
timeline.quote: "Triple the escort," Odric said.

timeline.summary: Grete's prison caravan carrying Gisa is attacked by misshapen skaabs and Gisa escapes in the chaos.
timeline.quote: we were overcome by a sudden attack of ghastly, violent, misshapen skaabs.

timeline.summary: Gisa writes to Geralf that she has broken out of prison.
timeline.quote: GUESS WHO JUST BROKE OUT OF PRISON!

timeline.summary: Gisa describes escaping her carriage and returning to the old family home in Nephalia.
timeline.quote: I swept my feet over my chains and rammed the door, escaping into the fog

timeline.summary: Gisa raises her dead parents to apologize for the fire that destroyed the house.
timeline.quote: I raised Mummy and Father to apologize for what we did to the house.

timeline.summary: Geralf scolds Gisa for raising their parents and tells her not to contact him again.
timeline.quote: You are being incredibly irresponsible.

timeline.summary: Grete tracks Gisa to the remains of an old manor in Nephalia.
timeline.quote: I have caught up with Gisa in Nephalia.

timeline.summary: Grete observes ghouls calmly walking toward Gisa's whistled summons along the Nephalian coast.
timeline.quote: They simply walk toward their conductor.

timeline.summary: Gisa meets Nahiri, who cuts down her summoned ghouls and then becomes her friend.
timeline.quote: the woman unsheathed a tremendous sword and severed each of my ghouls on the spot.

timeline.summary: Gisa raises an army of ghoul builders for Nahiri to construct a stone monument.
timeline.quote: My new friend asked for an army of builders, and I have raised her one!

timeline.summary: Geralf reveals he sent the skaabs to free Gisa from the prison caravan.
timeline.quote: I was the one who sent the skaabs to free you from the prison caravan.

timeline.summary: Grete withdraws toward Thraben as Gisa erupts in a violent rage.
timeline.quote: Departing immediately.

timeline.summary: Gisa rejects Geralf's help, boasts of her legacy with Nahiri and sends their dead mother to deliver her letter.
timeline.quote: I hope you don't mind I sent Mummy to deliver it to you.

timeline.summary: Gisa writes her brother that she is bored and has exhausted the living of Thraben, wishing for an opponent worthy of her.
timeline.quote: Things have been getting dreadfully dull here in Thraben.

timeline.summary: Geralf tells Gisa that she has only herself to blame and not to contact him again.
timeline.quote: Do not contact me again.

timeline.summary: Gisa smashes porcelain in a tantrum in the cathedral, having secured Thraben by eliminating most of the living after Liliana's zombies took it.
timeline.quote: The plate shattered against the wall

timeline.summary: Wilhelt, a risen ghoul with his own army, marches toward Thraben to win Gisa's love.
timeline.quote: At the head of his column of the dead, Wilhelt marched on Thraben

timeline.summary: Gisa writes Geralf another angry letter complaining that he will not send her anything to do.
timeline.quote: I knew you were my inferior.

timeline.summary: Geralf refuses again to come to Gisa's aid.
timeline.quote: No, I will not come to save you from the fruits of your own machinations.

timeline.summary: Gisa spots an army of the dead led by a rider approaching Thraben and runs to meet it, delighted to have something to do.
timeline.quote: Someone was riding along the road to Thraben.

timeline.summary: Wilhelt reaches the gates and declares himself to Gisa, who does not remember him and tries to whistle him into thralldom.
timeline.quote: Finally, tilting her head to the side, she asked, "Do I know you?"

timeline.summary: Gisa's whistle tries to bind Wilhelt, but he resists and breaks her hold; Gisa retreats behind the gates.
timeline.quote: breaking the tie between them as Gisa's whistle died, choked off in her throat

timeline.summary: Wilhelt breaks through the gates and his army is attacked by swarms of undead birds, then by the dead who surge out of the shops.
timeline.quote: They were halfway down the avenue when the dead surged out of the buildings to either side

timeline.summary: Gisa urges Wilhelt to surrender; he refuses, so she leaves her soldiers to overwhelm his.
timeline.quote: Then she flounced away down the walk, not looking back

timeline.summary: Wilhelt sends a ghoul with a love letter to Gisa, but she seizes the ghoul's mind and reads it.
timeline.quote: A single ghoul ran into the square

timeline.summary: Gisa reads Wilhelt's letter, is offended that he implies she could get his name wrong, and resolves to destroy him.
timeline.quote: She resolved to destroy him.

timeline.summary: Gisa screams and all the bats in Thraben descend on Wilhelt's army, forcing him to flee.
timeline.quote: Then Gisa screamed, and all the bats in Thraben descended.

timeline.summary: Wilhelt vanishes from the battlefield, and Gisa decides to go to her brother.
timeline.quote: Wilham himself was gone.

timeline.summary: Gisa writes to Geralf that she is on her way to him, and Geralf begs her to go anywhere else.
timeline.quote: I am on my way to you now and should be there inside of the sennight.

timeline.summary: Gisa writes to Geralf from the Engelturm, teasing him and mocking his skill as a ghoulcaller.
timeline.quote: What you do is no more than a pale imitation of my art

timeline.summary: Geralf replies, telling her to leave him alone as he researches corpses in the estuary that defy stitching.
timeline.quote: Corpses have been washing up in the estuary of late which defy all attempts at stitching.

timeline.summary: Bored at the Engelturm, Gisa watches Phyrexians shamble out of the Silburlind River.
timeline.quote: A small group of bipedal figures shambled out of the Silburlind River

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian cuts one of Gisa's ghouls in two with an oil-slick sword, and Gisa sends her dead to attack them.
timeline.quote: All around her, the dead she had risen for her own amusement turned toward the cluster on the shore.

timeline.summary: Gisa's ghouls destroy the group, but a Phyrexian corpse she raises collapses lifeless the moment her attention wanders; this has never happened to her before.
timeline.quote: This had never happened to her before.

timeline.summary: Gisa complains to Geralf that he has ruined the undead.
timeline.quote: You have ruined the undead. Do not do this again.

timeline.summary: Geralf warns Gisa not to touch the oil and reveals the invaders are Phyrexians, which Ludevic learned of after a fight with a strange white-haired visitor.
timeline.quote: DO NOT LET THE OIL TOUCH YOU!

timeline.summary: Gisa proposes a united game of NecroWarfare against Phyrexia, with Havengul or the Engelturm as the prize, and Geralf accepts.
timeline.quote: I propose NecroWarfare, us united against Phyrexia, winner take all.

timeline.summary: Gisa draws in the death of Innistrad and calls a moondrake and ghouls from the estuary muck.
timeline.quote: the undead moondrake she had called from the muck rose, majestic, into the sky.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian moondrake rises, and Gisa's moondrake kills it in the air and on the ground, spoiling a Phyrexian plan.
timeline.quote: her drake ripped the other's head clean off

timeline.summary: A second Phyrexian force approaches overland past the Engelturm, and Gisa complains it is cheating.
timeline.quote: "I said three-way, not four-way,"

timeline.summary: Not to be outdone, Gisa sings up a colossal chitinous beast from the bottom of the estuary, and it wades into the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Gisa's terrible new plaything rose from the bottom of the estuary

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians hack off the legs of Geralf's behemoth and then Gisa's sea-beast; both fall and Gisa stops laughing.
timeline.quote: Like the behemoth before it, it fell

timeline.summary: Geralf asks Gisa to give up her broken sea-beast so his skaabs can retrieve both monsters, and Gisa, after a tantrum, agrees on condition he owes her.
timeline.quote: If your creations can drag it back to your lab, I'll let it go. But you'll owe me!

timeline.summary: The fusion of behemoth and sea-beast rises and, with Gisa's ghouls, destroys the remaining attacking Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: watching the last of the attacking forces as they fell, screaming, before the tide of the dead.

timeline.summary: The siblings burn dead Phyrexians in a bonfire and bicker over who won the game; Geralf notes the fused beast has collapsed.
timeline.quote: "Neither of us won," Gisa snapped.

timeline.summary: Oko introduces the rest of the crew, including Gisa, Geralf, Eriette and Vraska, as his second-in-command.
timeline.quote: And Vraska—an assassin from Ravnica—is my second-in-command.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Oko, disguised as Sterling guards, ride the train with Umezawa while the rest of the crew watches over a telepathic link.
timeline.quote: The moment Oko's voice pressed into Kellan's mind, he flinched.

timeline.summary: Gisa raises zombies too early, and Sterling guards find Kellan, Oko and Umezawa in the luggage car.
timeline.quote: "She raised the zombies too early," Geralf groaned.

timeline.summary: The bridge explodes but the train does not slow, because the zombies have reached the conductor.
timeline.quote: The explosion was instant, echoing through the train walls and making the floor shake.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Oko cross the train roof, are attacked by Sterling guards, and are saved by Gisa's reanimated dead.
timeline.quote: Gray rotted arms closed around the guard's shoulders, and her weapon clattered to the ground.

timeline.summary: Oko sends Gisa and Geralf to retrieve the map from Thief's Folly.
timeline.quote: "Are the two of you up for a little side mission?"

timeline.summary: Gisa and Geralf return with the map, revealing the path to Tarnation and the vault.
timeline.quote: "I believe this is what you were after."

timeline.summary: Gisa raises a griffin-manticore from the ground and Geralf borrows a jackalope, and the siblings ride for Thief's Folly.
timeline.quote: the two of them were off, riding across the wide-open plains of Thunder Junction toward their distant, unpleasant destination.

timeline.summary: The siblings camp at night and Geralf observes that Gisa's zombies are not weakening, testing his planar theory.
timeline.quote: Her wellspring of Innistrad energy had yet to run dry.

timeline.summary: Geralf wakes Gisa, who fell asleep on watch, and they set off for Thief's Folly with her zombie animals following.
timeline.quote: They rode off into the dawn, Gisa's mismatched zombie army hopping, scurrying, and slithering after them.

timeline.summary: The siblings reach Thief's Folly and find it a patchwork of tombs from many planes.
timeline.quote: The architecture of the tombs and design of the grave markers were a patchwork amalgam of dozens of planes

timeline.summary: Geralf realizes the grave sigils are an incantation just as Gisa's whistling triggers a trap, and a giant corpsipede erupts.
timeline.quote: what looked like a centipede made from hundreds of bodies fused together

timeline.summary: Stella Lee, visiting Lucy Bluff's grave, hears the siblings arguing and meets them.
timeline.quote: Stella stepped around a crypt, and found herself looking at two pale, dark-haired people in tattered clothing.

timeline.summary: The corpsipede attacks and all three flee to the necropolis wall.
timeline.quote: "Run," said the man, grabbing the woman by the arm and charging straight toward Stella.

timeline.summary: Gisa whistles to take back her stolen magic from the corpsipede, shrinking it.
timeline.quote: "There," she said. "I've taken back what's mine."

timeline.summary: Gisa hums to track the foreign magic and leads them to a sealed Innistradi crypt, which Stella opens with her whip.
timeline.quote: When it struck the padlock, the shackle popped open and the lock fell away

timeline.summary: Gisa finds and destroys a beating heart and a centipede in a canopic jar, collapsing the corpsipede.
timeline.quote: Gisa straightened and stomped on the centipede, grinding it under her toe.

timeline.summary: Geralf takes the map from the sarcophagus and the group parts ways with Stella.
timeline.quote: reached inside the sarcophagus, rooting around until he came up with a map.

timeline.summary: Stella lets the siblings go, and they ride away still bickering.
timeline.quote: "I suppose there's no captures between friends."

timeline.summary: The crew fights the Hellspurs while Kaervek works, and Vraska suggests she and Oko must reach the treasure at any cost.
timeline.quote: "You and I need to reach the vault's treasure room. No matter the cost."

timeline.summary: Oko returns to the Wildcard Saloon and tells the crew that Vraska and Ashiok betrayed them.
timeline.quote: "Vraska and Ashiok were always planning to double-cross us.

timeline.summary: Oko disbands the crew with the promise of a future reunion, deciding to leave Kellan and Annie alone.
timeline.quote: "No. From now on, their business is their own,"

relations.note: Rival necromancers, though Geralf secretly helped her.
Wilhelt wants to be her king; she does not return his feelings.
Jeleva avoids Gisa for fear her mind would be damaged
relations.quote: None of the local vampires bothered her, out of fear of Jeleva

relations.note: Gisa and Geralf are necromancer siblings.
relations.quote: That's Gisa and Geralf, the necromancer siblings.

relations.note: The Cecani siblings are brother and sister and constant rivals.

pages_say.description: A necromancer being transported to Thraben, who caused great trouble with Geralf.
A necromancer ghoulcaller, Geralf's sister, who escapes prison, befriends Nahiri and raises ghouls to build a monument.
A ghoulcaller who rules Thraben with an army of the dead and writes bored letters to her brother; she defeats Wilhelt's army with bats.
A ghoulcaller who raises the dead by whistling and sings her creations back to life; she lives in the Engelturm and is Geralf's sister.
A necromancer on Oko's crew and Geralf's sibling.
A necromancer who raises zombies on the train, in constant conflict with her brother Geralf.
A necromancer who is sent with her brother to Thief's Folly to retrieve a map.
A ghoulcaller from Innistrad who raises the dead by whistling and bickers constantly with her brother Geralf.
